model.title: Veterans Flight Training Responsibility Act of 2026
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Thomas Kean (R-NJ)

summary.text: The bill would cap the amount of educational benefits that veterans can receive for flight training programs under the GI Bill, aiming to limit Department of Veterans Affairs spending on this benefit category.
